seed_ledger.name: Commonwealth Energy Connector Project
seed_ledger.reason: 6.35 mi 24-in Transco loop plus 33,000 HP at Station 168, Mecklenburg County VA, 105 MMcf/d for Virginia Natural Gas, in service 2025. Searched: EIA Aug 2026 row (power demand only), FERC order coverage (Argus, OGJ), trade press. Stated purpose is Virginia Natural Gas market growth and reliability; no source ties this project to data centers (DCD ties the separate Transco Power Express, P7800, to Virginia data centers). Search of state regulator, air permit, utility IRP not productive.

evidence.note: data center tie is for Power Express, not this project

seed_ledger.name: DT Midstream NEXUS interconnect for an Ohio data center
seed_ledger.reason: EXISTING_ROW: DT Midstream Q1 2026 call says new NEXUS mainline interconnect, 250 MMcf/d, supplies a behind-the-meter gas plant powering a new Ohio data center; management says it did not build a lateral, demand is added on the NEXUS mainline. DataCenter tag lead for P0225, no new pipe. Q2 2026 adds a further 380 MMcf/d interconnect for another Ohio data center plant.

evidence.note: DT Midstream Q1 2026 earnings call transcript, NEXUS interconnect for Ohio data center
